verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents downloading files from sites, uploading files to sites, or retrieving download artifacts after a session. Session recordings, screenshots and scrape outputs are different artifacts and are not file transfer. CDP/Playwright connectivity is only a developer building block, so none of these earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can download files from and upload files to the sites it operates, with the artifacts retrievable afterwards
